claim: In the HWA laboratory, a calendar object was created with $calendar NAME followed by free dates in mm/dd/yy. The calendar name is limited to 8 characters in the root folder. A job stream referencing FREEDAYS LABCAL before ON RUNCYCLE validated and was added.
source_url: local composer add and list calendar
supporting_quote: $calendar LABCAL; 12/25/26 01/01/26; FREEDAYS LABCAL validated. Name max 8 in root.
notes: FREEDAYS keyword must appear before ON RUNCYCLE.
